tagline: Sharp hooks, full coolers, and absolutely no bananas.
headline: We find the kings. You crank the reels.
meta_description: Guided salmon and trout charter fishing trips on Lake Michigan out of Muskegon. Licensed captain, all gear provided, morning and afternoon trips.
cta_heading: August kings book out by June.
hours:
Apr–Oct: daily trips at 6am & 1pm
Nov–Mar: off-season, book ahead
about: Thirty summers running this stretch of Lake Michigan and I still whoop like a rookie when the first rigger fires. I keep the hooks sticky-sharp, the tanks topped off, and bananas off my boat — laugh all you want, the cooler's done the talking since '96. Bring the kids, bring your crew, bring a camera; the Big Red and I handle everything else.

services.name: Morning & afternoon charters
services.desc: First-light and 1 p.m. runs — five solid hours with lines in the water.

services.name: Salmon & trout on Lake Michigan
services.desc: Kings, coho, steelhead, and lakers — we troll where the bait stacks up.

services.name: All rods, tackle & bait included
services.desc: Custom rods and whatever spoon was hot yesterday. Walk aboard empty-handed.

services.name: Fish cleaning at the dock
services.desc: Filleted, bagged, and on ice before you're done taking pictures.

services.name: Group & corporate trips
services.desc: Six aboard, coolers welcome — bachelor parties and office crews are our specialty.

why_us: Thirty years of waypoints — we don't go looking for fish, we go straight to 'em
You fight every fish yourself; the mate just hands you the rod
No bananas aboard since '96 — laugh all you want, then check the cooler
